task.title: Make battle receipt artifact status truthful and opt-in
task.scope: Remove the default artifact-worker call and prevent local artifact construction from being reported as durable receipt submission.

approval: Josh authorized beginning the bounded optimization after the DreamNet handoff requested one locally authorized narrow improvement.
intent: Eliminate default remote artifact calls and false submission language while preserving the optional configured artifact path and gameplay behavior.

evidence: The receipt adapter now requires BATTLE_TRAPPERS_URL before it calls fetch.
All adapter outcomes return submitted: false with an explicit deliveryStatus.
An offline mocked-fetch test was added for unconfigured, exported-bundle, and failed-build outcomes.
./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit, targeted ESLint, and git diff --check passed.
No live gateway, provider, deployment, contract, wallet, credential, or production configuration was contacted or changed.
All HTTP behavior in the focused test was mocked.

authority.basis: Josh directly authorized the optimization; the work stayed within the pre-existing no-deployment, no-credential, no-production-change boundary.

facts.label: CONFIRMED
facts.claim: The adapter can no longer report a locally built or exported artifact as submitted.

facts.label: CONFIRMED
facts.claim: Without BATTLE_TRAPPERS_URL, the adapter makes no fetch call.

facts.label: UNKNOWN
facts.claim: Deployed configuration, live worker behavior, durable delivery, independent verification, provider use, and production savings.
facts.source: No secret inspection, live request, deployment, or external readback was performed

handoff.next_action: Obtain owner-approved durable receiver and retention boundaries before designing authenticated submit/readback work.
blockers: No named durable receiver or independently verifiable readback contract is approved.
The current artifact worker only builds portable data and cannot establish delivery.
